description: Local-only real Server/daemon/Executor/Resource/ledger/MySQL process workload. It performs no third-party network access.
correctness_gates: every immutable input File Resource is read by a real daemon-hosted Executor
every import reaches previewed before a public confirm and completed after bounded apply
Company, item, Work, Attempt, and delivered dispatch counts exactly match the workload
all domain event intents reach the Atoll Channel ledger before measurement
at least two configured Executors receive successful Attempts when the workload has multiple Executors
Server restart preserves the ledger, Resource bytes, and byte-stable command replay
non_claims: this does not measure website latency or origin throttling
input File Resources do not substitute for response Artifact write-throughput
P0/P1/P2 are process-path baselines and are not the L0-L4 daily scheduling workloads
